metadata.description: Curated standard-UNIQUAC pure-component combinatorial r/q parameters used by the ester/alcohol interaction regressions.
notes: Ethyl propionate and ethyl butyrate are derived by group additivity from ethyl acetate, acetic acid, and the corresponding higher acid.
The values are standard UNIQUAC r/q parameters, not extended-UNIQUAC q-prime values.
